verdict.rationale: stagewise lets its agent change many items in one pass: it edits files across several connected workspaces, runs shell scripts, and runs multiple agents in parallel. A dedicated Diff Review page lists every modified file, and a single undo rolls back all changes from one agent action. However, bulk work happens through agent-driven multi-file edits and scripts rather than a documented bulk-operations feature, and the docs show no accept-all/reject-all batch controls. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk or batch operation capability, documented batch accept/reject across items, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale multi-item changes.
